mapper.select: SELECT id, title, type, applicant, applicant_id, department, content, status, approver, approver_id, approve_time, comment, create_time, update_time FROM approval WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO approval (title, type, applicant, applicant_id, department, content, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{type}, #{applicant}, #{applicantId}, #{department}, #{content}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
